def compute_threshold_and_climatology(baseline_dates, fs):
    """Compute thresholds and climatology for all days of year"""
    print("Computing thresholds and climatology from baseline period...")
    
    # Initialize pools dictionary
    pools = {}
    
    # Process each day of year (1-366)
    for doy in range(1, 367):
        if doy == 60:  # Skip day 60 initially since it needs special handling
            continue
            
        print(f"Processing day of year {doy}...")
        pool_values = compute_pools_for_doy(doy, baseline_dates, fs)
        pools[doy] = pool_values
    
    # Special handling for day 60 (February 29)
    # It gets values from days 59 and 61
    if 59 in pools and 61 in pools:
        combined_pool = pools[59] + pools[61]
        pools[60] = combined_pool
    
    # Compute thresholds and climatology
    thresholds = np.full(366, np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
    climatology = np.full(366, np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
    
    for doy in range(1, 367):
        if doy in pools and pools[doy]:
            pool = np.array(pools[doy], dtype=np.float64)
            # Remove NaN values
            pool = pool[~np.isnan(pool)]
            
            if len(pool) > 0:
                # Compute 90th percentile using linear method (Hazen equivalent)
                thresholds[doy-1] = np.percentile(pool, 90, method='linear')
                # Compute mean
                climatology[doy-1] = np.mean(pool)
    
    # Handle day 60 specifically - set to mean of days 59 and 61
    if 60 in pools and pools[60]:
        pool_59 = np.array(pools[59], dtype=np.float64) if 59 in pools else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
        pool_61 = np.array(pools[61], dtype=np.float64) if 61 in pools else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
        
        # Combine pools for day 60 (which should be mean of 59 and 61)
        if len(pool_59) > 0 and len(pool_61) > 0:
            combined_pool = np.concatenate([pool_59, pool_61])
            combined_pool = combined_pool[~np.isnan(combined_pool)]
            if len(combined_pool) > 0:
                thresholds[59] = np.percentile(combined_pool, 90, method='linear')  # Index 59 for day 60
                climatology[59] = np.mean(combined_pool)  # Index 59 for day 60
    
    return thresholds, climatology

def smooth_array(arr, window_size=31):
    """Apply circular moving average smoothing"""
    smoothed = np.zeros_like(arr, dtype=np.float64)
    half_window = window_size // 2
    
    for i in range(len(arr)):
        # Calculate the window indices with wrapping
        indices = [(i + j - half_window) % len(arr) for j in range(window_size)]
        window_values = arr[indices]
        # Remove NaN values for computation
        valid_values = window_values[~np.isnan(window_values)]
        if len(valid_values) > 0:
            smoothed[i] = np.mean(valid_values)
        else:
            smoothed[i] = np.nan
    
    return smoothed
